steps.en: Install nature-reader with the shared reference support package
steps.zh: 安装 nature-reader 与共享参考支持包

steps.en: Provide an authorized paper and request a bilingual reader
steps.zh: 提供有权使用的论文，要求双语阅读稿

steps.en: Route extraction by source format and assign stable source IDs
steps.zh: 按来源格式提取，并分配稳定来源编号

steps.en: Translate blocks and place figures and equations with source links
steps.zh: 翻译段落，放置带出处的图表与公式

steps.en: Check equation linkage and deliver Markdown plus source map
steps.zh: 检查公式连接，交付 Markdown 与来源映射

value.en: Keep the full-paper reading artifact traceable rather than silently reduced to a summary
value.zh: 完整阅读产物保留出处，不会悄悄缩成摘要
